Author: phuckspam2
Description:
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7437?tab=description]Mod[/url] originally created by spacechase0 [/b]I just rebuilt the mod following the creator's guide on their github, I made no changes to the mod but it works (so far) for 1.6. If the original creator comes back and updates the original mod I will take this down.

[b]Don't post bug reports hoping for a fix I am not the creator and I am not a programmer I don't know how to fix it, post them to make other users aware of them.[/b]
[b]
Original Mod Description:

Junimos Accept Cash[/b] lets you purchase community center bundles with gold.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Click the purchase button above the bundle icon in the community center UI to
complete the bundle.The price changes based on the most expensive items
left in the bundle.
